name: pet-agents
description: A pixel pet in your sidebar that acts out what your AI coding agent is doing, live. Sub-agents pop out as mini pets. Feed it, play fetch, collect toys.

commands.title: Pet Agents: Start a New Save
Pet Agents: Move Pet to Another Computer
Pet Agents: Bring Pet from Another Computer

pet-agents.color.markdownDescription: Fur/feather colour. Any CSS colour (`#ff8800`, `hotpink`, `rebeccapurple`...). Leave empty for the species default. Your AI agent can change this for you by editing your VS Code settings.

pet-agents.accentColor.markdownDescription: Belly, muzzle and chest colour. Any CSS colour (`#ff8800`, `hotpink`...). Leave empty for the default.

pet-agents.eyeColor.markdownDescription: Eye (iris) colour. Any CSS colour (`#ff8800`, `hotpink`...). Leave empty for the default.

pet-agents.accessory.description: Something for your pet to wear. Hats step aside for state props like the party hat.

pet-agents.accessoryColor.markdownDescription: Accessory colour. Any CSS colour (`#ff8800`, `hotpink`...). Leave empty for the default.

pet-agents.name.description: Your pet's name. Leave empty for the species default.

pet-agents.stateColors.description: Tint the pet and glow a coloured aura that changes with what the agent is doing.

pet-agents.wander.description: Let the pet wander around the panel and fidget when idle.

enumDescriptions: Mix it up: napping sideways or belly-up, hamster wheels, surfing the web, toys, idle hobbies...
Always the same animation for each activity
pet-agents.variety.description: How varied the pet's animations are.

pet-agents.disabledActions.markdownDescription: Animations and idle hobbies you never want to see, e.g. `running.zoomies`, `sleeping.belly`, `idle.butterfly`. Easiest to set from the ⚙️ button in the pet panel.

pet-agents.toys.description: Toys and furniture turn up around the pet, from common yarn balls to legendary finds. Your pet plays with them when idle.

pet-agents.machines.description: Show a machine (washing machine, oven, computer, engine...) for each test run, build or background job, with the pet waiting beside it.

pet-agents.backgroundPets.description: Show other busy Claude sessions in this repo (e.g. a second chat) as small pets along the bottom of the panel.

pet-agents.otherRepoPets.description: When no agents are running in this repo, show busy Claude sessions from your other repos (other VS Code windows) as small pets, labelled with their repo. They step aside as soon as an agent starts here, and never take over this window's pet.

pet-agents.holidays.description: Holiday events: decorations, an outfit and a limited-time toy for Halloween, Thanksgiving, Christmas, New Year, Valentine's Day and Easter, by your local date. Each window picks one of the holiday's outfits and decorations when it opens.

pet-agents.hemisphere.description: Which hemisphere's seasons show through the house window.

pet-agents.records.description: Weekly prompt records: the tiniest prompt with the longest run, the busiest prompt and more, worked out from your local Claude Code transcripts.

pet-agents.recordsShowPrompts.description: Show the start of each record-holding prompt on the records board. Off shows only the numbers and the repo. Prompts never leave your machine either way.

pet-agents.levels.description: Earn XP from finished prompts, passing tests and builds, helpers and care; level up to unlock furniture for the pet's house. Three new weekly challenges every Monday.

pet-agents.enemies.description: A failing test or build lets a bug or gremlin in, and a long wait for your OK lets a slime creep up. The next passing run squashes them.

pet-agents.house.description: A house for your pet (the 🏠 button): furnish it with what you unlock by levelling up.

pet-agents.style.markdownDescription: A themed look from a bag's pack (flower crown, snorkel mask, chef hat...). Each bag gives one free and sells colour variants in its shop; easiest to pick in the 🎒 Collection tab. A holiday costume shows over it while the event is on.

pet-agents.shareButtons.description: Show Post to X and Post to Bluesky buttons when sharing your progress. They only open your browser at a pre-filled post when you click them; nothing is sent otherwise.

pet-agents.visitors.description: While any care stat is at 40 or below, someone looks in every 40 minutes (every 30 once all three are at zero): a passer-by feeds your pet or a rain shower gives it a bath (each tops up a third of that stat), and very rarely a randomly made-up friend of the same species drops in to play with a toy from its bag. Looking after the pet yourself puts the next visit off for an hour.

scripts.pretest: npm run lint && npm run compile
